I do not put fertilizer on this rented piece because one bag is too much for such a small plot and I must save my money for the land I own. I will plant the seed I kept from last year and do the work myself with my family, as we always have. I do not spray chemicals or irrigate because this land is small and I have no water pump, and the rain has always been enough if God wills it.
